plan.scope: Rust constructed null expressions versus the committed, validated high-slice opt-in parent; strict emitter correctness correction.
plan.criterion: Every CPU/wall ratio-of-medians and simultaneous upper mean-ratio bootstrap bound <=5 percent. One final look; no unchanged-code repeat.
plan.execution: Seven comparisons on disjoint physical CPU pairs;384 paired rounds, balanced randomized order, no own builds/tests/captures/backends overlap.

lightwork_reservation_amendment.reason: Reserve a physical pair for light work; exclude it from workers before samples.

plan.failure_policy: Retain every observation and do not repeat unchanged code to chase a passing bound. Diagnose material regressions before publication; record failed confidence bounds honestly.
plan.build_binding: Record final binary and source hashes after parent integration, all gates, complete breadth review, and native proofs, before sampling.
